exposure: Maternal serum pregnancy-associated plasma protein A (PAPP-A)
Uterine artery Doppler ultrasound (Pulsatility Index (UtA-PI), Resistance Index, early blood diastolic incisors)
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women diagnosed with FGR and 120 normal pregnant women.
finding: The combination of maternal serum PAPP-A and uterine artery Doppler ultrasound is an effective method for predicting fetal growth restriction (FGR).
mod_finding: The FGR group exhibited significantly reduced rates of vaginal delivery and higher rates of cesarean section compared to the control group.
cross-section timing: Maternal serum PAPP-A and uterine artery Doppler ultrasonography were performed between the 11th and 13th+6 weeks of pregnancy.
